items.title: Kyiv infrastructure reportedly hit in missile strikes
items.summary: Missile strikes were reported in and around Kyiv, including near major crossings over the Dnipro River. Parts of the city reportedly experienced water and heating outages after damage to critical infrastructure. Additional strikes were reported in Kharkiv, Khmelnytskyi and Zaporizhzhia, but the overall damage remains unverified.

items.title: Kyiv metro infrastructure reportedly damaged amid missile strikes
items.summary: Explosions were reported in Kyiv during a new wave of suspected Russian missile strikes. Above-ground infrastructure on the city's green metro line, which crosses the Southern Bridge, was reportedly damaged; claims that the bridge itself was struck remain unconfirmed. The extent of the damage and any disruption to services are not yet clear.

items.title: Kyiv bridge closures reported following overnight strikes
items.summary: Traffic on Kyiv's Northern and Southern bridges was reportedly suspended after Russian strikes, with public transport diverted via the Podilskyi and Darnytskyi bridges. A ballistic missile strike on the Northern Bridge has also been alleged, but the precise damage and duration of the closures remain unverified.

items.title: Crimean Bridge traffic reportedly halted after another Ukrainian attack
items.summary: Ukrainian forces reportedly launched another attack on the Crimean Bridge, prompting a suspension of traffic across the crossing. The type of attack, any physical damage and the length of the closure have not been independently confirmed.
